statement: An employer with 100 or more employees (excluding part-time employees, or 100 or more employees working at least 4,000 aggregate hours per week) may not order a plant closing or mass layoff until 60 days after serving written notice on employee representatives or affected employees, the state dislocated-worker unit, and the chief elected local official, subject to the statute's reduced-notice exceptions (29 U.S.C. § 2101(a)(1), § 2102(a)-(b)).
caveat: Whether a layoff is a “mass layoff” depends on § 2101(a)(3) headcount and percentage tests at a single site, and several states (including CA and NY) have mini-WARN acts with lower thresholds. This repo does not determine WARN applicability.
